lint.command: uv run ruff check . && { command -v shellcheck >/dev/null || { echo "lint: required 'shellcheck' executable was not found; run 'just bootstrap' from the repository root to install it, then retry" >&2; exit 1; }; } && shellcheck scripts/*.sh .githooks/* && uv run oneagentgraph persona validate personas

test.command: env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 COVERAGE_FILE=.coverage.parallel uv run pytest --ignore=tests/plan_tooling --ignore=tests/session_setup --ignore=tests/host_sweep --ignore=tests/session_setup_pypi --ignore=tests/ask_seam --ignore=tests/dag_ui --ignore=tests/unwatched --ignore=tests/merge_policy --ignore=tests/writeback_budget --ignore=tests/run_end_hooks --ignore=tests/host_views --ignore=tests/project_store_race --ignore=tests/plan_store_assets --ignore=tests/render_diagram --ignore=tests/e2e --ignore=tests/unfinished --ignore=tests/graceful_cancel --ignore=tests/session_open_conflict --ignore=tests/manager_allowlist -m 'not reads_docs and not reads_recipes and not reads_checkouts' -n 4 --dist loadgroup --cov=orchestrator --cov-report= --cov-fail-under=0

coverage.command: rm -f .coverage && env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 uv run coverage combine --keep .coverage.parallel .coverage.e2e && env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 uv run coverage report

test-docs.command: rm -rf .telemetry/orchestrator/test-docs && env -u FORCE_COLOR BUDGET_TELEMETRY_DIR=.telemetry/orchestrator/test-docs NO_COLOR=1 uv run pytest --ignore=tests/plan_tooling --ignore=tests/session_setup --ignore=tests/host_sweep --ignore=tests/session_setup_pypi --ignore=tests/ask_seam --ignore=tests/dag_ui --ignore=tests/unwatched --ignore=tests/merge_policy --ignore=tests/writeback_budget --ignore=tests/run_end_hooks --ignore=tests/host_views --ignore=tests/project_store_race --ignore=tests/plan_store_assets --ignore=tests/render_diagram --ignore=tests/e2e/unpublished_view --ignore=tests/e2e/board_copy_approval --ignore=tests/unfinished --ignore=tests/graceful_cancel --ignore=tests/session_open_conflict --ignore=tests/manager_allowlist -m reads_docs --no-cov -n 4 --dist loadgroup

test-recipes.command: env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 uv run pytest --ignore=tests/plan_tooling --ignore=tests/session_setup --ignore=tests/host_sweep --ignore=tests/session_setup_pypi --ignore=tests/ask_seam --ignore=tests/dag_ui --ignore=tests/unwatched --ignore=tests/merge_policy --ignore=tests/writeback_budget --ignore=tests/run_end_hooks --ignore=tests/host_views --ignore=tests/project_store_race --ignore=tests/plan_store_assets --ignore=tests/render_diagram --ignore=tests/e2e --ignore=tests/unfinished --ignore=tests/graceful_cancel --ignore=tests/session_open_conflict --ignore=tests/manager_allowlist -m reads_recipes --no-cov -n 4 --dist loadgroup

test-checkouts.command: env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 uv run pytest --ignore=tests/plan_tooling --ignore=tests/session_setup --ignore=tests/host_sweep --ignore=tests/session_setup_pypi --ignore=tests/ask_seam --ignore=tests/dag_ui --ignore=tests/unwatched --ignore=tests/merge_policy --ignore=tests/writeback_budget --ignore=tests/run_end_hooks --ignore=tests/host_views --ignore=tests/project_store_race --ignore=tests/plan_store_assets --ignore=tests/render_diagram --ignore=tests/e2e --ignore=tests/unfinished --ignore=tests/graceful_cancel --ignore=tests/session_open_conflict --ignore=tests/manager_allowlist -m reads_checkouts --no-cov -n 4 --dist loadgroup

budgets.//: llmlint: ignore[expensive_tests_stay_behind_their_own_edge] The edge below is forced by the approved home of the board and lost-turn budgets, orchestrator/budgets.yaml, whose telemetry the orchestrator-e2e journeys record. It pulls that whole journeys tier into every check selecting this project: a cache replay when its key is unchanged, about thirteen minutes on a host with no cache entry for it. A drafted follow-up moves the measuring journeys into a test project of their own that this target depends on instead, and deletes this directive.
